title: The Somnolent Seat
subtitle: A chair for the Chamber
text: Sleep in it, or use it while seated, and you visit the Chamber of Will for a measured time: five minutes at the third Degree, ten at the fourth, twenty at the fifth. The visit is practice. The rite of the sixth Degree is a separate attunement. At Degree 3 it is raised as a Working craft. Build its frame beside the Cardinal Focus of a Greater Working floor or larger, seat a Sanguine Formation in the Focus and light two Blood Crystals and two Ender Pearls in the braziers. Feed the frame 250 mL and the floor takes it.
